prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the roadway with minor damage to the right rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the left front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that Vehicle 2 was attempting to change lanes from the center lane into the right lane while Driver 1 was already occupying the right lane, and that contact occurred along the left side of Vehicle 1. Driver 2 stated that they checked the mirror, believed the lane was clear, and moved over slowly, and that they felt the vehicles touch. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated at the scene by EMS, then declined transport. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 reported no injuries. Weather was clear and the pavement was dry. Skid marks were not observed. Both drivers were given exchange-of-information forms. Based on the statements and damage pattern, the investigating officer believes the sideswipe resulted from an unsafe lane change by Driver 2. Citation pending supervisor review.
